evaluation_label: retrospective_walk_forward_policy_assessment; the period has prior development exposure

depth_audit.additional_stored_execution_point: Exact aggregate fee-inclusive fill for $5 gross per side only
depth_audit.replacement_execution_model: best ask and saved quantity at that level only, with a fixed research minimum and no assumed liquidity beyond the recorded level

range_rationale.fixed_stakes: At $100 starting cash, $1/$2.50/$5/$10/$20 span 1% through the experiment's $20 technical ceiling; the fixed 5-share/$1 minimum is not tuned.
range_rationale.free_cash_fractions: 1%/2.5%/5%/10%/20% map to $1/$2.50/$5/$10/$20 at initial cash and shrink with available cash.
range_rationale.kelly: Quarter-, half-, and three-quarter Kelly are bounded by 5%/10%/20% of cost-basis equity and the common $20 ceiling.
range_rationale.return_thresholds: 0%/5%/10% are expected net profit divided by fee-inclusive cash debit; 5% and 10% are modest hurdles, and zero retains strictly positive-growth choices.
range_rationale.minimum_purchase: One fixed research floor of at least 5 net shares and $1 gross, followed by cent-down rounding; it is not selected against historical PnL.

frozen_search_space.trial_budget_basis: 15 fixed-stake + 15 free-cash-fraction + 27 fractional-Kelly configurations + no-trade; one shared cache load and sequential simulation
frozen_search_space.search_method: finite deterministic grid; no stochastic optimizer
frozen_search_space.minimum_expected_return_definition: expected net profit USD divided by full cash debit at the actually capped amount
frozen_search_space.selection_rule: For each side, calculate its own capped executable amount; among sides passing the return threshold, choose the side with the greater positive expected log change in cost-basis portfolio equity; ties choose UP
frozen_search_space.kelly_formula: Full Kelly solves the binary-outcome log-wealth optimum from fee-adjusted net payout per gross dollar and fee-inclusive cash debit per gross dollar; apply the fractional multiplier, then the cost-basis equity fraction and $20 caps; evaluate the rounded executable stake with the exact fee accounting

selection_objective: Mean daily log growth over inner chronological validation blocks, with no-trade growth zero; report PnL/final capital, cost-basis drawdown and duration underwater, trades, turnover, fees, exposure, stake-to-capital, depth/cash skips, and inability to place further orders.

split_design_frozen_before_search.method: Sort corrected eligible markets by entry_time_utc. First 20% is initial history; each outer block is 20%, preceded by a separate 20% policy-selection validation block.

outer_folds.capital_and_open_positions: Carry continuously across outer blocks; no per-fold reset. A later settlement can influence a refit only after outcome_available_at_utc.

split_design_frozen_before_search.availability_rule: Only labels with max(resolved_at_utc, market_start_utc + 5 minutes) strictly before the refit time enter selection.
split_design_frozen_before_search.crossing_positions: Carry cost basis and unsettled positions through block boundaries; cash is released only at max(resolved_at_utc, expiry) + 60 seconds.

execution_assumption.available_quantity: saved quantity at the native best ask only

minimum_purchase_assumption.gross_notional_rounding: round down to nearest $0.01 after cash and top-of-book caps
minimum_purchase_assumption.share_fee_rounding: historical replay rule: floor outcome-share fee to 6 decimals
minimum_purchase_assumption.cash_fee_rounding: historical replay rule: round fee to 5 decimals and apply $0.00001 minimum
minimum_purchase_assumption.historical_status: research assumption, not a confirmed historical venue rule
minimum_purchase_assumption.metadata_review: shared_market_evaluation contains order_min_size=5.0 for all rows, but no capture timestamp aligned to T-59; interpreted as shares for context only, not treated as historically verified

fee_model.rate_source: fee_rate_bps saved in the policy opportunity cache
fee_model.legacy_outcome_shares: fee_shares = gross_shares * fee_rate * min(price, 1-price) / price; floor fee_shares to 6 decimals; deduct shares from payout, not cash
fee_model.cash_collateral: fee_cash = round(gross_shares * fee_rate * (price * (1-price))^1, 5); zero it below $0.00001; add it to cash debit
fee_model.cash_debit: gross notional + cash fee; outcome-share fees do not add a cash debit
